ai.summary: Mysteries carry the channel: Gone Girl and Knives Out get twice the views per part of anything else, and people stay longest on parts that open with a question. Part 1s pull most views, so the cliffhanger at the end of Part 1 matters most.
working: Mystery recaps: 27k views per part vs 13k channel average
Parts opening on a question keep viewers 31s on average
Part 1 thumbnails with a close-up face get 2x the views
not_working: Sports drama (Runner): 3.6k views per part, 6% watch to the end
Hype edits get views but few follows
actions: Download more twisty mysteries and psychological thrillers
Keep parts near 3 minutes: longer ones lose people after 40s
End every Part 1 on an unanswered question

next_movies.title: Prisoners (2013)
next_movies.why: Mystery thriller, same audience as Gone Girl

changes.script_direction: Open each part with a question the viewer needs answered…

tuning.why: Parts over 3:15 lost 40% more viewers after the first minute.
